reportText: Workers observed without hard hats in active demolition zone near overhead crane operations

Scaffolding planks missing on level 3 of eastern face — exposed edge with 40-foot drop
Emergency exit door on loading dock floor is blocked by pallets of incoming freight
Temporary lighting outage in underground parking structure B — complete darkness
Welding operations conducted without fire watch or hot work permit in paint booth area
Damaged ladder with two cracked rungs still in service on upper floor renovation
Electrical panel cover removed and left open — live bus bars exposed in occupied hallway
Confined space entry in water tank without atmospheric testing or rescue plan on standby
Overhead crane hook missing safety latch — operators continue to use it for lifts
Traffic cones marking open trench removed by unknown party — trench now unmarked and unguarded
New employee orientation safety video skipped — three hires started work without training

Workers near unguarded roof edge on 6th floor without any fall protection system
